properties.title: Learning Cardiac Electrophysiology Digital Twins Through Agentic Discovery of Hybrid Structure
properties.contribution_type: Primary method – new model + agentic discovery

membership.reason: LEADS discovers patient-specific hybrid neural-diffusion + mechanistic-reaction ODE digital twins for cardiac electrophysiology.
membership.counting_boundary: Verified L1 hybrid mechanistic-neural organ dynamics world model (WT_ORGAN, BP_FORECAST).

properties.backbone: LLM-discovered hybrid cardiac EP reaction-diffusion ODE (neural graph diffusion + biophysical ionic reaction ODEs)

properties.flow: Observed cardiac EP trajectories -> LLM Observe-Think-Act architecture search -> gradient-descent parameter fit -> hybrid reaction-diffusion digital twin

properties.purpose: Patient-specific cardiac electrophysiology digital twin discovery and transmembrane/EGM trajectory simulation.
properties.environment: 3 synthetic reaction benchmarks + Utah animal-model EGM dataset [4]

assertions.rationale: Continuous transmembrane potential u and recovery variable v in R^N on heart mesh.
Discovers patient-specific hybrid structure and fits parameters via gradient descent.
Combines neural graph diffusion operators with biophysical ionic reaction ODEs.
Reaction catalog: Aliev-Panfilov, Rogers-McCulloch, Mitchell-Schaeffer ionic models.

Forward spatiotemporal cardiac EP trajectories are evaluated on held-out test splits across three synthetic reaction models (avg. test MSE 26.7e-3 vs 37.6e-3 human-designed hybrid and 416.3e-3 HDTwinGen, Table 1) and the Utah animal-model EGM dataset (test AT MAE 5.52 vs 5.64 human-designed hybrid, Table 2).
Outperforms human-designed hybrid models and unconstrained LLM baselines on 3 synthetic reaction models and real Utah EGM recordings.

evidence_fragments.content: Hence, we propose LEADS, a framework that formulates cardiac EP domain knowledge as a structured action space and utilizes an LLM agent to discover hybrid models. The agent follows an iterative reasoning-and-action loop to select, combine, and refine hybrid models, whilst gradient descent handles parameter fitting.

As illustrated in Fig. 1, LEADS uses an LLM agent to iteratively reason and search over a structured space of hybrid model components. The agent selects from a curated catalog of neural diffusion architectures and physics-based reaction models, and refines its choices based on empirical training feedback.

We evaluate LEADS on two cardiac EP settings: (1) Synthetic TMP trajectories generated from three ground-truth reaction models (AP [1], RM [16], MS [12]) with Laplacian diffusion (32 samples each; 20/6/6 train/val/test split), and (2) Real EGM recordings from the Utah dataset [4] (20 samples; 12/3/5 split).

We further validate LEADS on the real dataset Utah [4], which comes from animal model experiment. Lacking ground-truth kinetics and direct TMP observations, models are trained via a projected EGM loss and evaluated using test activation time (AT) MAE.

capability_assessments.rationale: Agentically discovered hybrid neural-diffusion + biophysical-reaction ODE cardiac electrophysiology digital twin forecasting spatiotemporal electrical activity (L1).

readiness_assessments.legacy_highest_label: R2 Synthetic + real clinical Utah EGM validation

limitations: Evaluation uses three synthetic reaction benchmarks and a single 20-sample Utah EGM dataset [4] that Section 4.3 (p. 7) explicitly states comes from an animal model experiment (despite the Conclusion on p. 9 referring to 'real clinical electrogram recordings'); no human retrospective clinical cohort (R2) or prospective ablation-guidance validation is demonstrated.
Single heart mesh geometry (1,119 nodes) and fixed diffusion/reaction catalog; no action-conditioned intervention or ablation control is evaluated.
notes: All 10 physical PDF pages extracted/read; page 4 visually inspected via rendered PNG.

legacy_cells.B: Learning Cardiac Electrophysiology Digital Twins Through Agentic Discovery of Hybrid Structure
legacy_cells.C: Zhou, Ziqi, Ye, Yubo, Vadhavka, Sumeet Atul, Wang, Linwei, Tao, Zhiqiang
legacy_cells.S: Can an agent-discovered hybrid reaction–diffusion model reproduce cardiac electrophysiology activation patterns from synthetic TMP trajectories and real EGM recordings?
legacy_cells.T: Synthetic TMP trajectories generated from three ground-truth reaction models, and real EGM recordings from an animal-model experiment (Utah dataset).
legacy_cells.AI: Synthetic transmembrane-potential (TMP) trajectories; real electrogram (EGM) recordings
legacy_cells.BI: LEADS (Learning Electrophysiology hybrid model through Agentic Discovery of Structure)
legacy_cells.BN: Reaction–diffusion ODE on a discrete heart mesh; a physics-based reaction-model catalog is paired with neural diffusion architectures.
legacy_cells.BS: Simulated transmembrane-potential trajectories and activation-time (AT) maps/patterns.
legacy_cells.BV: Sum of squared trajectory errors for candidate-model fitting; real EGM models use a projected EGM loss.
legacy_cells.DB: One LLM agent selects/refines candidate model structures; gradient descent fits candidate parameters.
legacy_cells.DC: Archive of prior candidates’ validation losses and per-epoch training curves; the agent observes this history.
legacy_cells.DF: ReAct-style Observe–Think–Act loop; structured diffusion/reaction catalogs; gradient-descent parameter fitting.
legacy_cells.DN: Synthetic TMP trajectories from AP, RM, and MS ground-truth reaction models; Utah dataset (real EGM recordings)
legacy_cells.DQ: Synthetic: 32 samples per ground-truth reaction model (AP, RM, MS); Utah real EGM: 20 samples.
legacy_cells.EA: Qualitative plausibility: on synthetic data LEADS reproduces ground-truth activation-time wavefront patterns; on real data it produces smooth AT maps more aligned with ground truth than the human-designed hybrid model.
legacy_cells.EI: Against non-agentic baselines: synthetic average test MSE was 26.7 for LEADS versus 37.6 for the human-designed Hybrid-Model; real-data AT error was 5.52 for LEADS versus 5.64 for Hybrid-Model, while Physics-Based scored 3.42.
legacy_cells.EJ: Against the LLM-driven HDTwinGen baseline, LEADS had lower synthetic average test MSE (26.7 vs. 416.3); HDTwinGen failed to produce cardiac activation and yielded uniform AT maps.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablations: Diff-Only, React-Only, and All-Neural were compared with LEADS on AP/RM/MS synthetic data; React-Only RM error was 20.4 vs. 10.1 for LEADS, and All-Neural AP error was 66.1 vs. 49.2.
legacy_cells.EL: HDTwinGen failed to produce cardiac activation on synthetic data and produced uniform activation-time maps.
legacy_cells.FB: Explicit physiological state variables: transmembrane potential u and recovery variable v on a discrete heart mesh.
legacy_cells.FL: An LLM agent searches/refines a structured catalog of neural diffusion modules and physics-based reaction models; gradient descent fits parameters of a reaction–diffusion ODE over heart-mesh states, with candidate trajectories evaluated by losses. No clinical action planner is evaluated.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces LEADS, an LLM-agent framework using a structured, domain-informed action space to discover hybrid cardiac electrophysiology models, with gradient descent fitting model parameters.
legacy_cells.FN: On synthetic data, LEADS achieved average test MSE 26.7 × 10⁻³ versus 37.6 for Hybrid-Model and 416.3 for HDTwinGen. On real Utah EGM data, LEADS test AT error was 5.52 versus 5.64 for Hybrid-Model; the optimally selected Physics-Based baseline scored 3.42.
legacy_cells.FO: The evaluation uses a single heart-mesh geometry and a fixed catalog.
legacy_cells.FP: The authors propose extending to multiple geometries, adding more diverse catalog components, and applying the approach to other physiological domains.
legacy_cells.FQ: Automatic discovery of patient-specific cardiac electrophysiology architectures from prior biophysical knowledge is described as underexplored.
legacy_cells.FR: The evidence demonstrates offline model-structure search and activation-pattern fidelity on synthetic trajectories and a small animal-model EGM dataset; it does not demonstrate treatment-conditioned or causally identified outcomes, clinical decision benefit, human-patient validation, prospective evaluation, or clinical deployment.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose future-state forecasts through a time-aware dynamics interface and validate error versus horizon; treatment actions need separate evidence before intervention simulation.
